name: toy_v1
description: Phase 1. Every optimizer on functions with known minima, deterministic full gradients, no weight decay. The learning rate for each (benchmark, optimizer) is the value in lr_grid that reaches tolerance in the fewest steps on tuning_seed (ties and misses broken by the lowest final f); that value is then used for every seed.
hypothesis: (1) On the quadratics, steps-to-tolerance of tuned plain GD grows roughly linearly with the condition number and momentum/NAG roughly with its square root, so the gap widens as kappa grows. (2) Newton reaches tolerance in one step on every quadratic; L-BFGS in a handful. (3) Lion's fixed-size sign steps stall above tight tolerances unless the learning rate is very small. (4) On Rastrigin no first-order optimizer reliably reaches the global minimum from random starts; final values depend mostly on the start point.

name: baseline_timit
description: Phase 2 on OptLab-TIMIT (open data, built by `optlab fetch-timit`). Late-fusion heads on cached CLIP / wav2vec 2.0 / frequency features, equal tuning budget per optimizer, 5 seeds. Train on VidTIMIT reals + DeepfakeTIMIT higher-quality fakes; in-distribution test on held-out identities of the same; "unseen" test on the same held-out identities with the lower-quality fakes (a different generator model size). Audio is untouched in the fakes, so the audio stream is a control that should carry no signal.
hypothesis: Adaptive optimizers converge faster but show a larger HQ-to-LQ generalization gap than SGD with momentum; SAM narrows the gap. The fitted fusion weight on audio is near zero for every optimizer.

name: baseline_timit_v2
description: Phase 2 on OptLab-TIMIT (open data, built by `optlab fetch-timit`). Supersedes baseline_timit, whose fake clips used DeepfakeTIMIT's 16 kHz resampled audio while the reals used the 32 kHz originals, which let the audio stream detect resampling artefacts (validation AUC up to 0.72 on audio alone). Here every fake has the real clip's original audio, so audio is identical across classes. Late-fusion heads on cached CLIP / wav2vec 2.0 / frequency features, equal tuning budget per optimizer, 5 seeds. Train on VidTIMIT reals + DeepfakeTIMIT higher-quality fakes; in-distribution test on held-out identities of the same; "unseen" test on the same held-out identities with the lower-quality fakes (a different generator model size). Audio is untouched in the fakes, so the audio stream is a control that should carry no signal.
hypothesis: Adaptive optimizers converge faster but show a larger HQ-to-LQ generalization gap than SGD with momentum; SAM narrows the gap. The fitted fusion weight on audio is near zero for every optimizer.

name: baseline_timit_v3
description: Phase 2 on OptLab-TIMIT (open data, built by `optlab fetch-timit`), restricted to the 32 people who appear both real and face-swapped (10 real + 10 fake clips each). Supersedes baseline_timit (fakes had DeepfakeTIMIT's resampled audio, so audio leaked the label) and baseline_timit_v2 (11 never-swapped people were always real, so cues identifying them leaked the label: audio alone reached validation AUC 0.64 with audio identical across classes). Here every audio clip appears once as real and once as fake with identical bytes, so audio cannot separate the classes. Late-fusion heads on cached CLIP / wav2vec 2.0 / frequency features, equal tuning budget per optimizer, 5 seeds. Train on reals + DeepfakeTIMIT higher-quality fakes; in-distribution test on held-out people; "unseen" test on the same held-out people with the lower-quality fakes.
hypothesis: Adaptive optimizers converge faster but show a larger HQ-to-LQ generalization gap than SGD with momentum; SAM narrows the gap. The fitted fusion weight on audio is near zero for every optimizer.

name: baseline_timit_cv_f0
description: Fold 0 of 8 of baseline_timit_cv. Gate 1 follow-up to baseline_timit_v3 on OptLab-TIMIT (32 face-swapped people, 16 swap pairs). (1) Fusion fits simplex weights together with a learned temperature, so the weights no longer absorb logit scale. (2) 8-fold cross-validation grouped by swap pair: each fold tests 2 pairs (4 people), validates on the next fold's 2 pairs (one for tuning, one for fusion) and trains on the other 12, so all 32 people are tested once and optimizers are compared paired by fold. Tuning budget, seeds and training settings as in v3.
hypothesis: Adaptive optimizers converge faster but show a larger HQ-to-LQ generalization gap than SGD with momentum; SAM narrows the gap. The fitted fusion weight on audio is near zero for every optimizer.

name: hybrid_toy
description: Phase 3 toy validation of the frozen hybrid and three ablations; known-minimum checks.
hypothesis: Blend and Lookahead alter stability; tight-tolerance convergence is measured rather than assumed.

name: hybrid_timit_cv_f0
description: Fold 0 of 8 of hybrid_timit_cv. Exploratory frozen-design hybrid and component ablations on the same 8 identity folds as calibrated_timit_cv. Earlier TIMIT test results have been observed; this is not a fresh confirmatory dataset.
hypothesis: RMS-matched Adam/momentum with Lookahead improves validation stability; test superiority is unknown. Compare the full hybrid to each removed component and three established baselines at equal tuning budgets.

name: finetune_timit
description: Paired raw CLIP control vs final block fine-tuning. One frame/video; fixed common LR, three epochs, no hyperparameter search. Exploratory TIMIT only.
hypothesis: Final-block fine-tuning changes detection relative to a matched frozen control; superiority is unknown.
